verdict.rationale: Vue's docs say it builds on standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript. A community user confirms that a single Vue component holds its HTML, JS and styles together, the single-file component pattern. One commenter notes that complex rendering logic must use Vue's template syntax rather than plain JavaScript, which is a secondary limitation rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the single-file component format, evidence that complex rendering logic can be expressed in familiar JavaScript within templates.
